biography.plain_text: Markos Nomikos is a Greek shipowner who leads A.M. Nomikos, the shipping business established by his parents, Anastasios and Angele. Based in Athens, he represents the next generation of a family enterprise that grew from coastal services into dry-bulk shipping. It maintains commercial operations in London and also manages container ships.

long_biography.plain_text:
A.M. Nomikos chief executive Markos Nomikos studied economics and business administration at the University of Buckingham before completing postgraduate study in shipping, trade and finance at City University, London. His work extends to the industry's technical and insurance institutions, including technical committees of ABS, ClassNK and RINA.

He chaired the UK Defence Club from 2023 to 2026, overseeing growth in its owned and chartered vessel membership and the return of funds to members. He remained on its board after handing the chair to Alex Stafilopatis. The club helps shipowners manage maritime disputes and meet the associated legal costs.
